translate_en|mods/CurlUp/42/media/lua/sh: Turning this on forcefully enables vignette for every player, and makes them use the vignette settings below.
Alpha of the vignette overlay, forced if "Force Vignette Settings" is ticked.
How long it takes for vignette to fade in, forced if "Force Vignette Settings" is ticked.
How long it takes for vignette to fade out, forced if "Force Vignette Settings" is ticked.

If "Stress Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum stress below which curling up won't reduce stress.
Otherwise, this is the maximum stress above which curling up won't add stress.

How much stress to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're curled up.
Note that nicotine stress isn't affected.

You'll only get warm up bonus if your temperature is below this.

36.5 is when "Chilly" moodle appears.

If "Unhappiness Per Minute" is negative, this is the minimum unhappiness below which curling up won't reduce unhappiness.
Otherwise, this is the maximum unhappiness above which curling up won't add unhappiness.
How much unhappiness to remove (negative) or add (positive) every game world minute while you're curled up.

Metabolic target when you're curled up, helps you warm up.

When you're sitting it's 1.0, walking is 3.1, running is 6.9, sprinting is 9.5.
